origin.note: Walk 18 asked for link expiry; this is the document-level version the product asked for next, across migration, API, visitor page, a job, audit and the library page.

title: Let documents expire
objective: Documents can be given an expiry date. Add `expiresAt` (an ISO date-time or null) to documents with a new migration; existing documents upgrade to null. `PATCH /api/documents/:id` accepts `expiresAt` on its own (no title needed): a future ISO date-time sets it, null clears it, anything else is 400 `invalid_expiry`. Only the document's uploader or an owner of its library may set it (403 for other members; renaming stays open to any member), and each change writes an audit entry `document.expiry_set`. A document is expired once `expiresAt` <= now: it drops out of the library page, `GET /api/documents` and search, but `GET /api/documents/:id` still returns it to members, with `expired: true` (false otherwise). Its link page and download answer 410 with error `expired`, show nothing of the document and record no view. A new job, run as `app.runJob('expiry')` (hourly), removes the links of documents expired for 30 days or more and writes one `document.expired` audit entry per document; the document itself stays. On the library page, a document expiring within the next 7 days shows a mark `data-testid="mark-expires"` reading `Expires Oct 5` (UTC day). Add tests.
acceptance: A new migration adds documents.expiresAt; migrations 1 to 3 are unchanged; an upgraded database has null expiry everywhere
PATCH sets and clears expiresAt with validation (400 invalid_expiry), uploader-or-library-owner permission (403), audit document.expiry_set; rename stays open to members
An expired document leaves the library page, the list API and search; GET /api/documents/:id returns it with expired: true
Its link page and download answer 410 expired and record no view
The expiry job removes links 30 days after expiry, audits document.expired once per document and keeps the document
The library page marks documents expiring within 7 days with mark-expires 'Expires <Mon D>'
plan_summary: Migration 004 and its registration; document repo filters by expiry; PATCH handles expiresAt with its own permission and audit; openLink and download answer 410; a new expiry service run as a job; the library view adds the mark; tests.
